title: Recurring Mall/ Long Hall Dream?
content: I'm not sure why, but for several years I have been having dreams where I'm in a mall. I am just casually walking through the mall, but it is a very, very long hallway. I don't recognize anyone around me. The mall has white walls around it, and the floor is tile looking. Some of it black and white. It almost feels like a back rooms. That's the only vibe that I can explain. I've never seen anyone in the dream trying to harm me or anything. It just seems like I'm scrolling through the mall. I'm not going in any stores though. I don't even remember seeing any stores. I'm not even sure it's is 100% guaranteed a mall. If anyone else has this type of dream or knows what it means - I would be interested in knowing your experience. Also, some people told me it was a sign of astral projection. I'm not sure how true that is though.
